claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean gate at interior product bias, every singleton-channel set J and nonnegative weights w, the sign-compatible Rayleigh packet Pi_J(w) defined in REPORT.md is bounded above by K_occ.

For every symmetric potential Gamma and genuine Boolean gate, R_Gamma >= Lambda_phys - T_Gamma + Pi_J^*. Hence Pi_J^* >= T_Gamma-Lambda_phys implies nonnegative gate residual; this includes composition-prime gates.

For the balanced six-bit distance-five two-flip dictator perturbation at center C=6.5584452830718245, each singleton B08 packet is below the negative B_inf debt, while the optimized sign-compatible six-singleton packet is above that debt.

partner_consumed.application: Used its center-neutral KL-insurance no-go to keep the new theorem source-dependent and its restriction exchange ledger to forbid double spending reference-movement KL.

remaining_implication: Prove universal coercivity for a sufficiently rich non-double-spent packet on every dangerous composition-prime source, or construct a genuine Boolean prime counterfamily.
